elections.quote: If the options are truly either we have to listen to you lie about voter fraud or let you pass a voter suppression bill, then fine - keep on lying.
Good news for Dems in NC: not only have they outregistered GOPs over the past few months, their margins have exceeded those of the same time period in the 2018 cycle.
I’d love to know how he calculated those odds without the knowledge of demographic turnout variations by day of ballot return.

Because Donald Trump convinced his supporters that mail voting was fraud, taking what was a great tactical advantage for his party and turning it on its head. 

Did Taibbi have his brain wiped clean or something? These aren't obscure political facts he's getting wrong.
One would think this guy would do a quick google before confidently stating that voters needed an excuse to cast a vote by mail “pretty much everywhere” before 10 years ago.

Good news for Dems - the Dem margin has been steadily improving among all groups since Trump took office. And this is the first time, outside of pre-election bumps, that the Dem downward turn among Black voters has reversed.  And Dems have even improved substantially with whites.
Let's keep in mind, the GOP reportedly spent upwards of $80 million on their primaries in Texas, well more than double the amount spent by Dems.
Here are 4 districts the TX GOP gerrymandered to gain seats in November, with the Dem and GOP primary vote. Dems outvoted GOPs in every one of them.

Wow, the Dem primary turnout among Hispanic voters in Texas is going to be giving the GOP sweats for the next 8 months. 

Take Zapata County - turnout in the Dem primary there yesterday was 143% the total number of votes Harris won in the 2024 general election. That's wild.
